blocks.title: 🔊 Meet the Drinks!
blocks.hint: Tap a card to hear it. Clap the syllables, then say it: whisper, normal, loud!

blocks.title: 💬 I Like…
blocks.hint: Choose a drink. Then grow your sentence, one step at a time.

blocks.title: ❓ Ask & Answer
blocks.hint: Tap 🔊 to hear the question and the answers. Then give your own answer!
lines: Yes, I do. I like milk.
No, I don't. I don't like tea.

blocks.title: 👂 Listen & Pop!
blocks.hint: Listen, then tap the drink you heard.

blocks.title: 🧩 Build the Sentence
blocks.hint: Tap the words in order: I → like → drink.

blocks.title: 🛒 The Drinks Café
blocks.hint: One is the shopkeeper, one is the customer. Then swap!

blocks.title: ⚖️ This or That?
blocks.hint: Which do you prefer? Finish the sentence with your own reason!
lines: I prefer milk to juice because it is creamy.
I prefer tea to water because it is warm.

blocks.title: 🎤 Talk Time
blocks.hint: Ask, then answer in a full sentence. Swap roles each time.
lines: What do you drink in the morning?

blocks.title: 🎉 Great job!
blocks.message: Great job! Now you can talk about drinks!
